title: Samsung Galaxy A5 review - with 4G and NFC support

asr.full_text: Hello everyone, I am Gogy from gogydoutin and you are watching the review of Samsung Galaxy A5. Now this is a better version as compared to A3 and this hand-set supports 4G. Inside the box you will find the Galaxy A5, its full metal body, quick start guide, warranty card, premium quality earphone, data cable, travel charger, earphone plug caps and sim tray ejector pin. A5 sports a 5 inch Super AMOLED screen with 1280 by 720 pixels resolution. It is slimmer than the A3. This is a dual-sim handset, built quality and the finishing is similar to as seen on the Samsung Galaxy A3. Full metal body with shiny silver borders the silver border gives a very elegant look to the handset you will also find the silver border on the buttons the front screen is slightly inside covered up by the metal frame the front screen also comes with dotted textures that are easily visible as as you can see here. The Camera module is a little light. There is a 2300 mAh built in battery. Samsung logo on the back. In-Call Speaker on the front, Samsung logo, sensor and 5MP Front Camera. Two touch navigation buttons and the dedicated physical button in the center micro USB 3.5 m audio jack and the mic is placed at the bottom volume rocker is placed on the left side there is a secondary mic on the top and on the right side you will find the power button along with two SIM slots. the handset supports Dual SIM, you need 2 Nano SIMs but in SIM Slot 2, you can either use a Nano SIM or a micro sd card, you cannot use both together I'm going to use a nano sim on sim 1 and I'm going to use a micro SD card on sim 2 Galaxy A5 weight with battery is 121 grams and it is 6 point double 6 mm thick. The handset is running Kitkat with touch vs UI. Touches very smooth and responsive. The navigation buttons they do light up. The handset comes loaded with 2 gb ram and 16 GB internal storage. Native video calling is supported. It's a 5 inchinch Super AMOLED HD screen and the viewing angles are pretty good. This handset supports Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, NFC, GPS, multi window, motion and gestures, private mode and ultra power saving mode. Of the 16 GB internal storage, you'll get around 11 GB free and of the 2GB RAM, you'll get around 1.2GB free on the first boot. OTG is not supported. I have connected an external OTG pendrive and there is no activity. Here is the camera interface, similar to as seen on the other Galaxy handset and there is the Download option. You can download additional modes. Rear camera is 13MP in 4-3 aspect ratio. You can shoot Full HD videos. And front camera is 5MP. This handset is powered by 1.2 gigahertz Cortex A53 quad-core processor with adreino 306 GPU, it is using the 64-bit MSM 8916 chipset running android kitkat. And here are the sensors, light, proximity accelerometer, and magnetic. Codent benchmark score is double-1 418 Antutu score is 19510 Villamo, Metal 943, Ninamark 2, 53.6 fps and this handset supports 10.0 multi touch. Let's play some games! Asphalt 8 set to the highest visual quality. This game got installed on the internal storage the gameplay is very smooth. This handset can play many high-end games, but do note that the applications are getting installed on the internal storage. Samsung Galaxy A5 is using a slightly different hardware as compared to the Galaxy A3. The A5 supports 4G. The performance is very good. This handset comes with a 13 megapixel rear autofocus camera and a 5 megapixel camera on the front camera quality is above average this handset can play full HD videos and the two thousand three hundred MAH battery will give you an estimated continuous usage time of about 4 to 6 hours. key highlights are Super AMOLED screen 2gb RAM NFC and 4 g support the samsung galaxy a5 is available for a price tag of APPROX 25,994 rupees. Visit my website to check sample images and videos. And if you liked this video, do hit the like button and don't forget to share.
